config._tax: Marketplace cut when you sell produce or bristles. VIP on the desert island = 12.5%.
config._coins_per_flower: Coins per FLOWER when coins are added into FLOWER totals. 0 = coins count as nothing (shown separately); e.g. 1000 to value them.
config._farmwide: Other-tree skills and crop items. speed_credit: share of a faster regrowth you actually use (you do not collect on every cycle). coins_per_flower: rate used to add coins into the total column.
config._price_overrides: Your own price for an item until a date (then the market price is used again).
config._derived_prices: Price items the market does not list from what they cost to make. Oil: one Oil Drill (20 Wood, 9 Iron, 10 Leather) per drill; drills give 10, 10, then 30 = 50 per 3.
config._builds: Skill builds to compare, applied to your live skills: remove these skills, then add {skill: rank}. The first one is your plan.
config._no_ticket_weeks: Week numbers (0 = week starting 9 Nov) whose board has no ticket bounties. One per chapter; which one is a guess.
config._buildings: Building level by week: [[from_week, level], ...]. Week 0 starts 9 Nov.
config._upgrade_paths: Building paths to compare for tickets and value: [[from_week, level], ...]. Barn = cows + sheep (buffer 1), Pigpen = pigs on bounties + trade-in.
config._capacity: Slots per building level (sfl-manager). Chicken Coop adds +5 per Hen House level, Barn Blueprint +5 per Barn level.
config._board: Animal bounties per week per building level. Hen House L3 and Barn L3 from the SFL wiki; the rest are guesses.
config._ticket_base: Base Duende Caps per animal ticket bounty: GUESS until 9 Nov. The +1 per Duende wearable is added automatically.
config._herd: How you run each building. buffer = animals kept beyond this week's requests (null = keep it full). Several buffers are compared. stop_feeding_at: "auto" = highest level boards ask for. trade_in_at: trade pigs for bristles at this level.
config._boosts: Cheap upgrades to test on top of your plan (first build, buffer 1). price in FLOWER is refreshed from the sfl-manager NFT catalog when found.
config._tickets: Chapter ticket plan. Deliveries get VIP +2 and +1 per Duende wearable; bounties only the wearables.
config._npcs: base = tickets before bonuses (sfl-manager). freq = share of days you deliver. exclude = never counted, even in the maximum.
config._board_items: Weekly non-animal board. per_week = requests; tickets = base per request (GUESS until 9 Nov, replaced by the live board); share = how many you turn in.
config._chores: Chore tickets per week (none shown yet on your board).
config._flower_plan: Your clock: hours from UTC (Brazil = -3) and the hours you are awake to plant and harvest.
config._must_have: Harvests you need by a deadline (your local time), e.g. a weekly chore. Planned first.
